parsed.name: BioShake微孔板恒温振荡器
parsed.description: 一体化的加热与振荡平台，用于固定并振荡微孔板或样品托盘。设备带有可夹紧的板夹机构、温控单元（加热，可能支持主动冷却）以及可调速的振荡/加速/减速控制，常用于样品孵育、混匀和温控反应。
parsed.description_en: An integrated heater and orbital shaker platform for clamping and agitating microplates or sample trays. The device includes a plate-clamping mechanism, temperature control (heating, with possible active cooling support), and adjustable shaking speed, acceleration and deceleration—used for incubating, mixing and temperature-controlled sample processing.

actions.description: 停止温度控制（关闭加热/温控功能）
将机械平台回到原点位置以初始化设备（回零）
actions.description_en: move the mechanical platform to its home position to initialize the device

actions.description: 夹紧并固定放置在振荡平台上的微孔板或样品板
actions.description_en: physically clamp and secure a microplate or sample plate to the shaker platform

actions.description_en: initialize the device: perform reset and optionally home to prepare for operation

actions.description: 以指定速度和加速度启动振荡以混匀样品（针对微孔板/托盘）
actions.description_en: start shaking at the specified speed and acceleration to agitate samples (for microplates/trays)
